widgets_values:
Bart's Lora Selector: several LoRAs on one node. Press "+ Add LoRA..." to open the picker: a card for every file in the loras folders, a filter by model family, a search by name or trigger word, and a panel with the trigger words, recommended settings and training data of the selected one (your own notes can be saved there). Each row has an ON/OFF switch and a strength; a new row appears when the last one is filled. Connect the CLIP too to set a CLIP strength per row.
Set the checkpoint in Load Checkpoint; `lora_names` (the LoRAs in use, comma separated) goes to the preview. Metadata is read from the safetensors header and from foo.civitai.info / foo.json / foo.preview.png next to a LoRA.
